description: Microsoft Foundry provides Azure-hosted OpenAI models plus selected first- and third-party models sold directly by Azure and partner models offered through Azure Marketplace.
residency_notes: Azure Direct Models process prompts within the customer-specified geography for regional deployments, while Global and DataZone deployments have broader processing rules. Models are stateless for ordinary inference, but stateful features such as Responses, Threads, files, vector stores, and stored completions persist data in the customer's Azure geography; modified abuse-monitoring controls can disable abuse-prompt storage only with approval.
prompt_training_notes: Microsoft says Azure OpenAI prompts, completions, embeddings, and training data are not used to improve OpenAI models, Azure OpenAI models, or third-party models.

sources.notes: Authoritative model catalog, deployment-type, capability, and regional-availability reference for models sold directly by Azure.
Authoritative lifecycle and retirement schedule for Azure-hosted and Marketplace partner models.
The GA v1 API uses the /openai/v1 base path; callers pass their deployment name in the model field.

verification.notes: Verified against Microsoft Learn. Model availability and price depend on deployment type, Azure geography, subscription eligibility, quota, and for Marketplace offers the partner terms.
